sources.title: State House of the Republic of Zambia

capital.evidence_quote: Lusaka is the constitutional capital, commercial core, and seat of government of Zambia

currency.evidence_quote: The Zambian Kwacha (ZMW, K) is the official sovereign legal currency regulated by the Bank of Zambia

timezone.evidence_quote: Zambia observes Central Africa Time (UTC+2) uniformly year-round with no daylight saving shifts

voltage.evidence_quote: Standard single-phase domestic electrical distribution in Zambia is 230V at 50 Hz

frequency_hz.evidence_quote: The interconnected southern African grid delivers synchronized 50 Hz power across Zambia

plug_types.evidence_quote: British Type G plugs are dominant in modern hotels and lodges, alongside Type C and legacy Type D

police.evidence_quote: Dial 991 nationwide for emergency police dispatch and highway patrol intervention

ambulance.evidence_quote: Dial 992 nationwide for hospital emergency ambulance dispatch services

fire.evidence_quote: Dial 993 to summon municipal fire brigade and industrial rescue teams

general.evidence_quote: Dial 112 (or 999) from any mobile network for general emergency routing

source.title: US Department of State Travel Advisory

advisory_headline.tr: Standart Önlemler (Safari ve Doğa Turizmi Açısından Son Derece Güvenli)
advisory_headline.en: Exercise Normal Precautions (Exceptionally Peaceful & Safe Safari Destination)
advisory_headline.de: Normale Vorsicht (Außerordentlich friedliches und sicheres Safari-Reiseziel)
advisory_headline.ru: Стандартные меры предосторожности (Исключительно мирное и безопасное сафари-направление)
advisory_headline.es: Precauciones normales (Destino de safari excepcionalmente pacífico y seguro)

regional_warnings.area: Urban bus depots and market areas in Lusaka after dark
regional_warnings.reason: Petty opportunistic pickpocketing; avoid walking alone at night outside secure compounds

mobile_down_mbps.evidence_quote: Zambia records median mobile cellular download speeds around 21.4 Mbps on Airtel and MTN 4G networks

fixed_down_mbps.evidence_quote: Zambian fixed broadband infrastructure provides median download speeds around 16.2 Mbps

esim_sim_notes.value: SIM cards require mandatory biometric and passport registration with Airtel or MTN; major safari lodges provide satellite Wi-Fi
esim_sim_notes.evidence_quote: ZICTA directives require strict physical passport identification for SIM registration

religion.value: Christianity (~95% majority - Protestant and Catholic), small Muslim and Hindu communities
religion.evidence_quote: Zambia is constitutionally declared a Christian nation, with freedom of conscience protected

festivals.value: Kuomboka (Lozi royal boat voyage), Ncwala (Ngoni first fruits), Shimunenga, Umutomboko, Likumbi Lya Mize
festivals.evidence_quote: Over 20 traditional ceremonies celebrated annually, led by Kuomboka on the Zambezi floodplain

legal_cultural_warnings.value: Wearing military-style camouflage attire is illegal for civilians; maintain strict safe distances from wildlife in national parks; respect traditional chiefs and ceremonies; possession of pornography and narcotics strictly banned
legal_cultural_warnings.evidence_quote: Camouflage clothing prohibited under national law; strict wildlife safety guidelines enforced

tipping.value: Customary in safari lodges and upscale dining; 10% in restaurants; tipping safari guides ($10-15/day) and camp trackers ($5-10/day) is established standard etiquette
tipping.evidence_quote: Safari tipping is customary practice supporting park guides and conservation trackers
